name: A Week to Remember
storyline:
Daniel Hernandez Florez has fallen into a depressive episode following the disappearance of his boyfriend, Elliot. Nightmares of a corrupted Elliot who can't remember him haunt Daniel. Celia, gifted witch and Daniel's older sister, returns home to aid in the search. When she finally coaxes him outside, Daniel finds Elliot lost and suffering from amnesia.

With little options, Elliot goes home with the sibling duo, where each day they craft spells and take Elliot places to help him recover his memory.

As Daniel helps Elliot, his own memories resurface, hidden in the neglected spaces and forgotten objects around his house. Each day brings them closer to uncovering the truth, but something has made its way inside Elliot... and it's only a matter of time before it claws back out.
summary: Help Elliot recover his memories and unlock the truth of what happened before it's too late. A Mexican-American gothic, boys' love visual novel, featuring interactive spell crafting and point-and-click exploration.
